title: Data-free continuous-time physics-informed neural networks for vortex shedding: a consistent pressure across time windows
abstract: arXiv:2611.33489v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Without data, physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) in continuous time have so far failed to develop vortex shedding past a circular cylinder in a domain symmetric about the wake centerline: the training converges to the steady symmetric solution. We obtain shedding at Re=100 with a continuous-time PINN trained over successive time windows, without any reference data and without temporal discretization, the symmetry being broken by an analytical, divergence-free initial condition. The Strouhal number and the mean drag coefficient agree with an OpenFOAM solution computed on the same domain to within 0.5%. The pressure, however, is discontinuous at the junctions between windows, and the lift coefficient is a staircase. We relate this discontinuity to the differential-algebraic structure of the incompressible Navier-Stokes equations, of index 2 after spatial discretization: a consistent initial condition of each window must satisfy the

translated_title: 面向涡旋脱落的无数据连续时间物理信息神经网络：跨时间窗口的一致压力
translated_abstract: 在没有任何数据的情况下，连续时间的物理信息神经网络（PINNs）迄今未能在关于尾流中心线对称的计算域内发展出圆柱绕流的涡旋脱落现象：训练收敛于稳态对称解。我们通过在相继的时间窗口上训练连续时间PINN，在Re=100条件下获得了涡旋脱落，其中不使用任何参考数据、也不进行时间离散化，对称性由一个解析的、无散度的初始条件打破。斯特劳哈尔数与平均阻力系数与在同一计算域上计算的OpenFOAM解吻合，误差在0.5%以内。然而，压力在窗口交界处不连续，升力系数呈阶梯状。我们将这种不连续性与不可压缩Navier-Stokes方程的微分代数结构联系起来，该结构在空间离散化后为指标2：每个窗口的一致初始条件必须满足……
tldr: 该研究首次在完全无数据且无时间离散化的条件下，通过解析无散度初始条件打破对称性，在相继时间窗口上训练连续时间PINN实现了Re=100圆柱绕流的涡旋脱落，并将窗口交界处压力不连续归因于不可压缩Navier-Stokes方程指标为2的微分代数结构对一致初始条件的要求。
en_tdlr: This study obtains data-free vortex shedding past a circular cylinder at Re=100 with a continuous-time PINN trained over successive time windows using an analytical divergence-free initial condition to break symmetry, and traces the pressure discontinuity across window junctions to the index-2 differential-algebraic structure of the incompressible Navier-Stokes equations requiring consistent initial conditions.
